title: Pankai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes his mention in [Pesachim 57a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.57a.10) as disparaging and counts him among the High Priests of the Second Temple period.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage names Pankai as Yochanan ben Narbai’s teacher and praises the student’s entry to eat sacred offerings. [Heilprin’s Pankai entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2981&lang=en) also describes him as Yochanan’s teacher. Hyman describes the mention as disparaging and includes Pankai among the High Priests.
